content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Bitcoin ebook

Gumroad, the popular platform for selling digital products, charges a flat fee of 3.5% plus $0.30 per transaction, which adds up quickly, especially for low-priced ebooks. On the other hand, NOWPayments, the payment service offered by COREMERCH, charges a mere 0.5% fee per transaction, with no additional charges for small transactions, making it a more cost-effective option for ebook authors who want to maximize their earnings.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and other traditional payment processors often impose harsh restrictions on creators from certain countries, including Zimbabwe, where PayPal and Stripe are blocked, making it difficult for ebook authors to reach their target audience. NOWPayments, on the other hand, offers a more inclusive approach, allowing creators to collect payments directly from customers in restricted countries without any additional hurdles or fees.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

While Gumroad and other traditional payment processors may offer faster payment processing times, NOWPayments ensures that payments are processed quickly and efficiently, with an average transaction time of just 1-2 seconds. Moreover, with a 0.5% fee, NOWPayments offers a more transparent and cost-effective payment solution, making it easier for ebook authors to calculate their real costs and maximize their earnings.
Automated delivery means the download link arrives before the buyer navigates away from the payment confirmation page.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Every digital file type — ebooks, fonts, presets, plugins, templates — works with the same automated delivery pipeline.
